Principle 4A:
Introducing My Relatives
Greeting
Next, I’d like/love to tell you about my family.
My Parents and Siblings
Because I am the oldest (not the oldest) we visit my family very often (not very often).
My parents live close by, so I try to visit them two times a month.
My family and I are close, and when we get together, we like to go out to dinner together and talk for hours.
My father used to be a businessman, but he is retired now.
He often goes hiking in the mountains with his friends.
My mother still loves to prepare delicious meals and look after her grandchildren.
I have 2 brothers and 2 sisters.
They are all married, and I have lots of nieces and nephews.
My Wife’s Family
My wife has many relatives because her father and mother have many brothers and sisters, too.
She has (2) brothers and (2) sisters.
Because her family doesn’t live near us, we visit them once a month.
My father-in-law used to be a teacher, but now he is retired like my father.
He likes to go hiking a lot.
My mother-in-law loves to watch our children and always helps my family, too.
In her free time, my mother-in-law likes to go shopping and visit the local sauna with her friends.
My wife’s siblings live near by, so we usually visit them once a month.
